question: How do I place an order?
keywords: buy purchase checkout cart add item
answer: Browse the store, add items to your cart, then click Checkout. Enter your delivery address, choose a payment method, and confirm. You will receive an order confirmation email within a few minutes.

question: How can I track my order?
keywords: tracking status where is my package parcel delivery location
answer: Open the confirmation email and click Track Order, or sign in and go to My Account > Orders. Tracking updates appear once your order has been handed to the courier.

question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
keywords: modify edit update cancel order change address
answer: You can change or cancel an order within 1 hour of placing it from My Account > Orders. After that, the order is already being prepared, and you will need to return it once it arrives.

question: I did not receive an order confirmation email. What should I do?
keywords: email confirmation missing receipt spam not received
answer: Check your spam or junk folder first. If it is not there, sign in and look under My Account > Orders. If the order is not listed, the payment may not have completed, so please try again or contact support.

question: How long does delivery take?
keywords: shipping time days arrive estimated how long delivery speed
answer: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 working days. Remote areas may take up to 3 extra days.

question: How much does shipping cost?
keywords: delivery fee price charge rate free shipping
answer: Standard shipping costs 1,500 NGN. Orders above 50,000 NGN ship free. Express shipping costs 3,500 NGN.

question: Do you ship internationally?
keywords: overseas abroad outside country worldwide international deliver ghana uk usa europe countries
answer: Yes. We ship to selected countries in Africa, Europe, and North America. Delivery takes 7 to 14 working days, and customs fees may apply on arrival.

question: What is your return policy?
keywords: return send back refund policy exchange days
answer: You can return unused items in their original packaging within 14 days of delivery. Start a return from My Account > Orders and we will send you a return label.

question: How long does it take to get a refund?
keywords: money back refund processing time reimbursement
answer: Refunds are issued within 5 to 7 working days after we receive and inspect your return. The money goes back to your original payment method.

question: What should I do if my item arrives damaged or faulty?
keywords: broken defective wrong item damaged not working missing
answer: We are sorry about that. Send us a photo of the item and the packaging within 7 days of delivery, and we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
keywords: pay card debit credit transfer paystack bank ussd wallet cash on delivery
answer: We accept debit and credit cards, bank transfer, USSD, and Paystack. Cash on delivery is available in Lagos and Abuja only.

question: Is it safe to pay on your website?
keywords: secure security safe fraud encryption card details protected
answer: Yes. All payments are processed through encrypted, PCI-compliant providers. We never store your full card details.

question: My payment failed but money was deducted from my account. What now?
keywords: charged debited failed transaction declined error deduction
answer: Do not worry. Failed transactions are usually reversed automatically within 24 to 72 hours. If the money is not back after 3 days, contact support with your transaction reference.

question: Can I use a discount code or voucher?
keywords: promo coupon code voucher offer deal discount apply
answer: Yes. Enter your code in the Promo Code box at checkout and click Apply. Only one code can be used per order, and codes cannot be combined with sale prices unless stated.

question: How do I create an account?
keywords: register sign up join new account registration
answer: Click Sign Up at the top right, enter your name, email, and a password, then confirm your email address. You can also check out as a guest.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
keywords: reset change recover login sign in locked out forgot password
answer: On the Sign In page, click Forgot Password and enter your email address. We will send you a link that lets you set a new password. The link expires after 30 minutes.

question: How do I update my delivery address or phone number?
keywords: edit profile details contact information address change
answer: Sign in and go to My Account > Profile. You can update your name, phone number, and saved addresses there.

question: How do I know if an item is in stock?
keywords: availability available stock out of stock restock back in stock notify
answer: Each product page shows its stock status. If an item is sold out, click Notify Me and we will email you when it is back in stock.

question: Do your products come with a warranty?
keywords: guarantee warranty covered repair electronics manufacturer
answer: Electronics come with a 12-month warranty. Other products are covered against manufacturing defects for 3 months. Keep your receipt as proof of purchase.

question: How can I contact customer support?
keywords: help support phone call email whatsapp agent talk to human working hours open
answer: Email support@shopease.example or call +234 800 000 0000, Monday to Saturday, 8am to 6pm (WAT). We usually reply to emails within 24 hours.
